lines.zh: 我踏在草地上，草顺着我走
lines.en: I step on the grass and it flows with me

lines.zh: 我的蹄下冒出一小片新绿
lines.en: A little new green rises under my hooves

lines.zh: 我是一匹会走路的草皮

lines.en: I scatter grass bits behind me when I run

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛是一条条草茎
lines.en: My mane is strands of grass stems

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方比刚才更绿
lines.en: The ground I tread is greener than before

lines.zh: 我的身体和草地一起晃
lines.en: My body sways with the meadow

lines.zh: 我从这边草皮走到那边
lines.en: I walk from one patch of turf to the next

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，草没被踩坏
lines.en: I walk steadily, the grass unharmed

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫倒一片草尖

lines.zh: 我的背上冒出一朵小花
lines.en: A small flower opens on my back

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一个草垛
lines.en: I stay still like a haystack

lines.zh: 风把我的鬃毛吹成一片波浪
lines.en: The wind turns my mane into a wave

lines.zh: 我身上的草又密了一层
lines.en: The grass on me has thickened another layer

My breath carries a smell of soil

One spot on me is especially green

lines.zh: 我慢慢把蹄子挪了个位置
lines.en: I slowly shift my hooves to a new spot

lines.zh: 我在你脚下种了点东西
lines.en: I planted something under your feet

lines.zh: 我不疼，我只是不再那么绿
lines.en: I do not hurt, I am only less green

lines.zh: 我慢慢站着等它长回来
lines.en: I stand slowly and wait for it to grow back
A lot of my grass was torn off

The flower on my back fell off

lines.zh: 我不疼，只是变得不那么绿
lines.en: I do not hurt, I am only less green

The grass in your hand is very green
I can take this
The grass on me is not thick enough
Put it down and I will come myself

Yours has no roots
Grass needs soil to live
Let me smell where it came from

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只是把它种下去
lines.en: I do not eat it, I plant it
I could take a little of this
You trampled my grass
I step back and the grass slowly stands up

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，草屑乱飞
lines.en: We collided and grass bits flew
The grass in my mane got squashed
A few blades came off
You pressed a dent into the turf

lines.zh: 我的蹄子往旁边挪了挪
lines.en: My hooves shifted aside

lines.zh: 我们撞到一起，草味很浓
lines.en: We bumped and the smell of grass is strong

lines.zh: 我挡在那一小片草前面
lines.en: I stand in front of that little patch

lines.zh: 我退了半步，草跟着我动
lines.en: I back half a step and the grass moves with me
I am made of grass and clay
We only meet in the soil
I have no part in it
I am growing new leaves
I turn my head aside

lines.zh: 我把它按进背上的草里
lines.en: I press it into the grass on my back

lines.zh: 坐稳了，前面有人要拦路。
lines.en: Hold on tight — someone's blocking the road ahead.

lines.zh: 我在等它走出这片草地
lines.en: I wait for it to leave this meadow

lines.zh: 我撞过去，草和土一起飞

lines.zh: 我落地时草被压平又弹回
lines.en: The grass flattens on my landing and springs back

lines.zh: 我从一块草皮里立起来
lines.en: I rise out of a block of turf

lines.zh: 草先从我的背上长出来
lines.en: Grass grows out of my back first

lines.zh: 我是草和灵魂沙做的马
lines.en: I am a horse made of grass and soul sand

lines.zh: 我和这片地分不出边界
lines.en: You cannot tell where I end and the ground begins

lines.zh: 火把我的草全部烧黑了
lines.en: Fire burned all my grass black

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，草撒了一地
lines.en: I hit the ground from height and my turf flew

lines.zh: 水把我身上的草压成一片
lines.en: Water pressed the grass on me flat

lines.zh: 爆炸把我整片绿都掀走了
lines.en: The blast tore away every blade I had

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我背上的草
lines.en: An arrow passed through the grass on my back

lines.zh: 那股术力让我的草长得飞快
lines.en: That magic made my grass grow wildly fast

lines.zh: 雷把我的草烧成一条焦线
lines.en: Lightning burned a scorched line through my grass
